generic_gaussian.model: one occupied mode of h=d.sigma; d=(sin(theta)cos(lambda), sin(theta)sin(lambda), cos(theta)+V)
generic_gaussian.distribution: V uniform on [-W,W], fixed along lambda

project_bdg_twist_loop.distribution: independent on-site V_i uniform on [-W,W] for every orbital; fixed along the loop
project_bdg_twist_loop.averaging: circular mean modulo pi; RMS uses wrapped deviations modulo pi
